summary: Trivial boolean wrapper: returns whether SessionStateCheck(this) is non-zero. It forwards its own 'this' object directly to SessionStateCheck and converts the result to a boolean.

operations.description: Return non-zero iff SessionStateCheck returned a non-zero state.

Used as a boolean session-state gate by callers across multiplayer placement, session end-condition checks, debug display, UI command handling, vehicle/tire simulation, pit logic and video restart paths.

unresolved: The state values produced by SessionStateCheck are not defined here.
Why this thin wrapper exists as a separate function instead of calling SessionStateCheck directly is not established.
